title: userspace proxy mode no longer supported

detection.reason: read from the kube-proxy ConfigMap's own mode field; a mode passed only as a --proxy-mode container arg is not read here

quote: The "userspace" proxy mode (deprecated for over a year) is no longer supported on either Linux or Windows. Users should use "iptables" or "ipvs" on Linux, or "kernelspace" on Windows.
remediation: Switch the mode to `iptables` or `ipvs` (Linux) or `kernelspace` (Windows) BEFORE the upgrade. kube-proxy does not fall back — it fails to start, and every node it fails on stops programming Service rules.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get cm -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | startswith("kube-proxy")) | (.data // {}) | to_entries[] | .value | scan("(?m)^ *mode: *\"?([a-z]+)") | .[0]'  # prints the configured kube-proxy mode; userspace no longer starts on 1.26
